title: The boundary of the unit section is the extension class
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal O_X\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with Yoneda class $e\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)$. Under the canonical identification from [lem-sc-ext-locally-free], $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)=H^1(X,\mathcal A)$, the connecting homomorphism $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)\to H^1(X,\mathcal A)$ sends $1$ to $e$.
